Mobile boat mechanics in New Port Richey, Port Richey and Holiday, FL

The Pithlachascotee River, the Gulf Harbors and Flor-A-Mar canals, and the Pasco coast flats are trailer-boat and lift-boat territory. Pasco mechanics in the network serve the whole coast from Holiday to Hudson.

Waters
  • Pithlachascotee (Cotee) River
  • Gulf Harbors canals
  • Pasco coast flats and the Anclote Keys
  • Durney Key and the near-shore islands
Ramps and marinas
  • Nick's Park (Port Richey)
  • Gulf Harbors ramp
  • Brasher Park
  • Anclote Gulf Park (Holiday)
  • Key Vista Nature Park
Boats we see

Bay boats, flats skiffs, pontoons, airboats, kayaks; a strong scallop-season fleet.

What breaks in New Port Richey

  • Shallow coast and oyster bars: props, skegs, and lower units
  • Scallop season (July to September) crowds and breakdowns
  • Trailer bearings from frequent ramp launches

Questions we get

My lower unit hit bottom on the flats. Can you check it?

Yes: gear oil check for water and metal, prop shaft runout, and a pressure test. Catching it early is the difference between a seal and a rebuild.
